parties: Inox Green Energy Services Limited (IGESL) and Inox Renewable Solutions Limited (IRSL)
headline: Inox Green Energy Services Limited: Scheme of Arrangement – Allotment of Equity Shares
sum: IGESL completed allotment of equity shares to IRSL shareholders pursuant to an approved Scheme of Arrangement, facilitating a restructuring between the two Inox renewable entities.
implication: Scheme allotments post-sanction require careful compliance with shareholder notification and stock exchange intimation timelines; this ruling-stage disclosure confirms regulatory & exchange clearance before allotment execution.
detail: Inox Green Energy Services Limited intimated the NSE of the allotment of equity shares to shareholders of Inox Renewable Solutions Limited following approval of their Scheme of Arrangement. The scheme represents a corporate restructuring between two Inox Group renewable subsidiaries. The allotment was executed after all regulatory and judicial approvals, with formal notice filed on 24 August 2026 as required under securities law and exchange rules.
